title: Repro: every agent-written change, reproduced and verified before it merges
description: Repro checks out a change's base and head as isolated snapshots, runs them, records what each side does (test outcomes and function-level behaviour traces), diffs that behaviour, checks declared invariants, and has reviewer agents judge the change's claims against that evidence. The result is a Reproduction Card per change: VERIFIED, FLAGGED or UNVERIFIABLE, with the evidence and an explicit list of what could not be checked.
